paragraphs.text: translated by
1. His life hath been renewed and carried forward as two men, car-borne, by the skillful driver.
paragraphs.original: प्र तार्यायुः प्रतरं नवीय स्थातारेव क्रतुमता रथस्य ।
paragraphs.translit: pra tāryāyuḥ prataraṃ navīya sthātāreva kratumatā rathasya |

paragraphs.text: One falls, then seeks the goal with quickened vigour. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.
paragraphs.original: अध च्यवान उत्तवीत्यर्थं परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम्
paragraphs.translit: adha cyavāna uttavītyarthaṃ parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām

paragraphs.text: 2. Here is the psalm for wealth, and food, in plenty: let us do many deeds to bring us glory.
paragraphs.original: सामन्नु राये निधिमन्न्वन्नं करामहे सु पुरुध श्रवांसि ।
paragraphs.translit: sāmannu rāye nidhimannvannaṃ karāmahe su purudha śravāṃsi |

paragraphs.text: All these our doings shall delight the singer. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.
paragraphs.original: ता नो विश्वानि जरिता ममत्तु परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम्
paragraphs.translit: tā no viśvāni jaritā mamattu parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām

paragraphs.text: 3. May we o'ercome our foes with acts of valour, as heaven is over earth, hills over lowlands.
paragraphs.original: अभी ष्वर्यः पौंस्यैर्भवेम द्यौर्न भूमिं गिरयो नाज्रान् ।
paragraphs.translit: abhī ṣvaryaḥ pauṃsyairbhavema dyaurna bhūmiṃ girayo nājrān |

paragraphs.text: All these our deeds the singer hath considered. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.
paragraphs.original: ता नो विश्वानि जरिता चिकेत परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम्
paragraphs.translit: tā no viśvāni jaritā ciketa parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām

paragraphs.text: 4. Give us not up as prey to death, O Sorna still let us look upon the Sun arising.
paragraphs.original: मो षु णः सोम मृत्यवे परा दाः पश्येम नु सूर्यमुच्चरन्तम् ।
paragraphs.translit: mo ṣu ṇaḥ soma mṛtyave parā dāḥ paśyema nu sūryamuccarantam |

paragraphs.text: Let our old age with passing days be kindly. Let Nirrti depart to distant places.
paragraphs.original: द्युभिर्हितो जरिमा सू नो अस्तु परातरं सु निरृतिर्जिहीताम्
paragraphs.translit: dyubhirhito jarimā sū no astu parātaraṃ su nirṛtirjihītām

paragraphs.text: 5. O Asuniti, keep the soul within us, and make the days we have to live yet longer.
paragraphs.original: असुनीते मनो अस्मासु धारय जीवातवे सु प्र तिरा न आयुः ।
paragraphs.translit: asunīte mano asmāsu dhāraya jīvātave su pra tirā na āyuḥ |

paragraphs.text: Grant that we still may look upon the sunlight: strengthen thy body with the oil we bring thee.
paragraphs.original: रारन्धि नः सूर्यस्य संदृशि घृतेन त्वं तन्वं वर्धयस्व
paragraphs.translit: rārandhi naḥ sūryasya saṃdṛśi ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva

paragraphs.text: 6. Give us our sight again, O Asuniti, give us again our breath and our enjoyment.
paragraphs.original: असुनीते पुनरस्मासु चक्षुः पुनः प्राणमिह नो धेहि भोगम् ।
paragraphs.translit: asunīte punarasmāsu cakṣuḥ punaḥ prāṇamiha no dhehi bhogam |

paragraphs.text: Long may we look upon the Sun uprising; O Anumati, favour thou and bless us.
paragraphs.original: ज्योक्पश्येम सूर्यमुच्चरन्तमनुमते मृळया नः स्वस्ति
paragraphs.translit: jyokpaśyema sūryamuccarantamanumate mṛḷayā naḥ svasti

paragraphs.text: 7. May Earth restore to us our vital spirit, may Heaven the Goddess and mid-air restore it.
paragraphs.original: पुनर्नो असुं पृथिवी ददातु पुनर्द्यौर्देवी पुनरन्तरिक्षम् ।
paragraphs.translit: punarno asuṃ pṛthivī dadātu punardyaurdevī punarantarikṣam |

paragraphs.text: May Soma give us once again our body, and Pusan show the Path of peace and comfort.
paragraphs.original: पुनर्नः सोमस्तन्वं ददातु पुनः पूषा पथ्यां या स्वस्तिः
paragraphs.translit: punarnaḥ somastanvaṃ dadātu punaḥ pūṣā pathyāṃ yā svastiḥ

paragraphs.text: 8. May both Worlds bless Subandhu, young Mothers of everlasting Law.
paragraphs.original: शं रोदसी सुबन्धवे यह्वी ऋतस्य मातरा ।
paragraphs.translit: śaṃ rodasī subandhave yahvī ṛtasya mātarā |

paragraphs.text: May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.
paragraphs.original: भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत्
paragraphs.translit: bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat

paragraphs.text: 9. Health-giving medicines descend sent down from heaven in twos and threes,
paragraphs.original: अव द्वके अव त्रिका दिवश्चरन्ति भेषजा ।
paragraphs.translit: ava dvake ava trikā divaścaranti bheṣajā |

paragraphs.text: Or wandering singly on the earth. May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.
paragraphs.original: क्षमा चरिष्ण्वेककं भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत्
paragraphs.translit: kṣamā cariṣṇvekakaṃ bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat

paragraphs.text: 10. Drive forward thou the wagon-ox, O Indra, which brought Usinarani's wagon hither.
paragraphs.original: समिन्द्रेरय गामनड्वाहं य आवहदुशीनराण्या अनः ।
paragraphs.translit: samindreraya gāmanaḍvāhaṃ ya āvahaduśīnarāṇyā anaḥ |

paragraphs.text: May Heaven and Earth uproot and sweep iniquity and shame away: nor sin nor sorrow trouble thee.
paragraphs.original: भरतामप यद्रपो द्यौः पृथिवि क्षमा रपो मो षु ते किं चनाममत्
paragraphs.translit: bharatāmapa yadrapo dyauḥ pṛthivi kṣamā rapo mo ṣu te kiṃ canāmamat
